changes.value:
SELECT
    t.TICKET_ID,
    t.CUSTOMER_NAME,
    t.PRIORITY,
    t.STATUS,
    a.AGENT_NAME,
    a.TEAM,
    t.OPENED_TS,
    t.CLOSED_TS,
    DATEDIFF('hour', t.OPENED_TS, t.CLOSED_TS) AS RESOLUTION_HOURS,
    t.CHANNEL
FROM DCM_DEMO_DEV.RAW.TICKETS t
JOIN DCM_DEMO_DEV.RAW.AGENTS a
    ON t.AGENT_ID = a.AGENT_ID
